title: Generic instruction forms (Unary/Binary/Icmp)
description: Collapse InstData into generic forms (Binary{op}, Unary{op}, Icmp{cc}, Iconst) so parse, print, verify and args() are generic and each backend only gains a match arm per op. Prerequisite for the rest.
close_reason: InstData now has Binary{op: BinOp}; parser, printer, builder and both backends are generic over BinOp

title: x86_64 emission: iced-x86 CodeAssembler -> bytes + asm text
description: Use iced-x86 (code_asm) to encode and its formatter for textual asm (Intel or GAS). Expose both bytes and text from the backend interface.
acceptance_criteria: Filetest on asm text for add function.

title: wasm backend: single-block, binary + WAT
description: One local per SSA value. Encode with wasm-encoder, print WAT with wasmprinter. Reject multi-block with clear error until stackifier exists.
acceptance_criteria: Filetest on WAT output; wasmparser validates binary.

title: x86_64 backend: lowering to vcode + trivial regalloc
description: Lower sir to machine-level IR with virtual regs; trivial regalloc behind its own module (swappable for linear scan); SysV ABI (rdi,rsi -> rax). Shape lowering for later parallel moves on block-param edges.
acceptance_criteria: Lowered vcode is printable and deterministic.

title: Verifier (SSA, dominance, terminators, types)
description: Checks single def, use dominated by def, block params/branch arg arity, exactly one terminator per block. thiserror + miette diagnostics referencing entities.

title: Textual printer (clif-like, with basic blocks)
description: Format: function %add(i64, i64) -> i64 { block0(v0: i64, v1: i64): v2 = iadd v0, v1; return v2 }
acceptance_criteria: Builder output prints to expected text.

title: Filecheck filetest harness
description: tests/filetests/*.sir with first-line '; test <stage>' directive; one harness in tests/ globs, runs stage, matches output with the filecheck crate. Stages: print, verify, x86_64, wasm. Project rule: e2e tests only, no unit tests in src/. Run via cargo nextest r --release.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test runs filetests; failure shows useful diff.

title: IR data model (Function/Block/Inst/Value, i64 only)
description: Arena-backed entity ids (u32). Entry block params are function params. Block params instead of phis. Terminators separate from insts. Ops: iconst, iadd, return. Keep a Type enum with single I64 variant so adding types later is not a rewrite.
acceptance_criteria: Types compile; exercised by e2e filetests (no unit tests).

title: FunctionBuilder API with eager SSA checks
description: create_block/switch_to_block/iconst/iadd/ret/finish. Eager checks: operand belongs to function, no insts after terminator, every block terminated, no value redefinition (no mutable Variable API). finish() runs verifier and returns Result.
acceptance_criteria: README example builds and finishes, verified via e2e tests under tests/; misuse cases return typed errors, also tested e2e.

title: SBE v0: sir -> x86_64 + wasm
description: Small backend: sir IR (i64 only, SSA, basic blocks with params), builder API, textual format, null sopt, x86_64 and wasm backends emitting text asm AND binary. Lean on crates for encoding/assembling/linking; runtime execution only as dev-deps. Frontends emit SSA via FunctionBuilder.

title: modules: e2e tests and docs
description: filetests + execution tests (wasmi with host import, C-harness link with extern) and docs updates.

title: x86_64: call lowering, callee-saved regs, relocations
description: SysV call lowering (arg regs, rax result), values live across calls in callee-saved regs with prologue/epilogue and 16-byte alignment, R_X86_64_PLT32 relocations, module ELF object.

title: wasm: module compile with imports and calls
description: wasm::compile_module: import section first in function index space, one export per defined function, call by index.

title: sir: Module with functions and imports
description: Module holds defined functions and declared imports (name+signature); verify_module checks each callee resolves with matching signature; text parse/print of multi-function modules.

title: sir: call instruction and function refs
description: Add FuncRef (fnN) declared per function with name+signature, a Call inst taking 0..1 results (callee signatures limited to <=1 return), builder, verifier (arity/types), printer, parser. Void calls need optional inst result.

title: Modules, calls and imports
description: Add a Module holding multiple functions. call by function reference, declared external imports (signature only), wasm import section/function indices, x86_64 call lowering and relocations. Needed for the platform layer; precedes memory.

title: i64 arithmetic, bitwise, shift and divide ops
description: isub, imul, ineg, band, bor, bxor, bnot, ishl, ushr, sshr, sdiv, udiv, srem, urem. Division by zero and INT_MIN/-1 trap (matches wasm and x86 #DE). Lowered on x86_64 and wasm, with filetests.
close_reason: 13 binary and 2 unary i64 ops lowered on x86_64 and wasm; reference-checked on both

title: i8/i16/i32 types and integer extend/reduce
description: Add Type::I16 and Type::I32 (I8 already exists from the icmp epic). Make int ops generic over all widths. Add sextend, uextend, ireduce. Wasm holds i8/i16 in an i32 with undefined upper bits and normalizes (extend8_s/extend16_s or mask) before compares, div/rem, right shifts, extends and stores. x86_64 uses 8/16-bit forms or widens and normalizes the same way.
close_reason: i16/i32 types, width-generic int ops, sextend/uextend/ireduce on sir, wasm and x86_64

title: icmp, select, i8 bool type; brif requires i8
description: Add Type::I8. icmp with IntCC returns i8 (0/1). select takes an i8 cond. brif cond must be i8 (verifier rejects other types). Update the existing brif filetests. Wasm represents i8 as i32; general i8 arithmetic comes with the i8/i16/i32 epic.
close_reason: icmp (10 condition codes), select, Type::I8; brif and select require i8 cond; verifier type-checks every inst; i8 function params rejected until normalization lands in sbe-3pu

title: Execution tests (dev-deps only): x86_64 and wasm
description: Execution tests (dev-deps only). x86_64 (mmap, tests/x86_64_exec.rs) and wasm (wasmi, tests/wasm_exec.rs) execution tests already exist. Remaining: link the .o from sbe-dx8.11 with a small C harness via cc and run it.
acceptance_criteria: add(2,3)==5 on both targets in cargo test.

title: Object output via 'object' crate
description: Wrap emitted code into ELF relocatable (x86_64) so system cc/ld can link it. Do not write our own linker.

title: Textual parser with miette spans
description: Parse the text format back into Function. Run verifier after parse.
acceptance_criteria: print->parse->print roundtrip; syntax error filetests show spans.

title: sopt: Pass trait + null pass
description: trait Pass { fn run(&mut self, &mut Function) }, pass manager, null pass. Verify between passes in debug.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline runs null pass; IR unchanged.

title: Memory: load/store, stack slots, pointer type
description: Decide pointer-width story first (target-parametric vs fixed). Add load/store, stack slots, address-of. Wasm needs a shadow stack in linear memory for address-taken slots. Blocked on the pointer-width decision.
close_reason: load/store/stack_addr with i64 addresses fixed-width; wasm shadow stack, x86_64 stack frame

title: More control flow: br_table/switch, trap, unreachable
description: Add switch terminator (wasm br_table via stackifier, x86 jump table or compare chain), trap and unreachable.

title: Multi-block: jump/brif and block-param lowering
description: Add jump/brif. x86: parallel moves on edges. wasm: stackifier/relooper for arbitrary CFGs.
acceptance_criteria: Loop and diamond filetests + execution tests.

title: Floating point: f32/f64 and ops
description: Add f32/f64, fadd/fsub/fmul/fdiv, fcmp (returns i8), conversions. Both wasm and SSE support them natively. Backlog.
